name: touchpad-snap
description: Bridge for the touchpad-snap program: switch between windows and apps, send shortcuts and run commands from global hotkeys and modifier + touchpad swipes. Holds no policy; exposes the window list, global hotkeys and gestures on the session bus, which Wayland offers no other way to reach. Needs the touchpad-snap daemon (https://github.com/hjosugi/touchpad-snap).
